sources.snippet: With the development of mobile terminals and Internet technology, people have increasingly convenient mediums to obtain digital music. However, complex music genres and massive music libraries have brought great challenges to music information retrieval. Music genres are high-level labels for music information, which would consume a lot of time and resources when manually tagged.
